episodes.title: Yo nunca nunca
episodes.summary: Adriana is a successful professional with a perfect but boring marriage. One day, she runs into Sergio, a high school friend she has always had a crush on. Sergio organizes a get together with 4 couples, opening the door to the game of keys.

episodes.title: Vainilla no es el único sabor
episodes.summary: While the game of keys was unfulfilled, every couple is excited by the thought of what would happen if they opened up to new sexual experiences. Adriana decides to take action and gets her friends together to play the game of keys at her home.

episodes.title: El doble de "Rayan Gosling"
episodes.summary: The four couples exchange partners with each other: the game of keys has begun. This will be the opportunity to fulfill their hidden fantasies, challenging the principles of their sexuality.

episodes.title: Una "placencia" oral
episodes.summary: Adriana remains obsessed with the idea of the game of keys, while Oscar tries to convince her to give up and rebuild their relationship instead. The constant presence of Sergio will test the couple's strength.

episodes.title: Habrá consecuencias
episodes.summary: Fantasies are unleashed: Adriana tries to save her marriage while Sergio calls for another game of keys, generating new doubts. Leo fantasizes about his children's governess, and Valentin relishes in his imagination his repressed desires.

episodes.title: Oscarín… ¡Oscarón!
episodes.summary: The new game of keys generates very diverse sensations in Adriana and her friends, from frustration to extreme pleasure. Some couples are strengthened and others start distancing themselves irremediably. It's time for new discoveries.

episodes.title: Enloquéceme yei yei yei
episodes.summary: True feelings come out. There are passions that cannot be repressed and everyone seems willing to experiment, although this could destroy homes, couples, friendships and, above all, commitments supposedly made for life.

episodes.title: Los niños necesitan disciplina
episodes.summary: The couples try to rebuild their relationships and Adriana proposes a trip to the countryside with her family. Meanwhile her friends are living their best lives with their partners, as her days gets worse by the minute.

episodes.title: ¡Deja de decir condón!
episodes.summary: The couples are on the verge of collapse, unaware of how they have each reached this place emotionally. New sexualities, demands, doubts, ambiguities and even old and obsolete ideals threaten to destroy them.

episodes.title: Declaro inaugurado "El juego de las llaves"
episodes.summary: In a huge mansion, Siena commences the last game of keys where passions are to be explored by a sea of guests. There, not only will desire be unleashed, but the darkest truths will come to the surface.

episodes.title: Odio El Juego de las Llaves
episodes.summary: A few months have passed since the last game. Adriana left Oscar and now he lives with Gaby... and Mica. Valentin came out of the closet and is trying to be happy in this new stage of his life. Barbara and Leo were stripped of their belongings by Aurelia's lawsuit but they adopted Carmen and now have a "throuple." Everyone seems to be in crisis, unable to make sense of their lives.

episodes.title: Con ustedes… ¡Astrid y Gloria!
episodes.summary: Adriana blames Siena for everything that has happened since they met. Siena introduces her to Astrid, and they both convince her this is her chance to live with total freedom. Gloria, Barbara´s mother, appears uninvited at the footstep of Barbara´s house. Valentín tries to come out of the closet to his mother, while Gaby and Oscar try to rekindle their former spark.

episodes.title: Un juego saca otro juego
episodes.summary: Adriana attends her first game with Siena and Astrid. Thanks to Guillermo, a super-hot teacher and Siena, she is initiated into sex between more than two people. Valentin cannot convince his mom to let him tell his father the truth. Barbara can´t stand her mother being in her house and Gaby notices that Oscar has no interest in what is about to happen to them as a couple.

episodes.title: Regreso al juego
episodes.summary: After winning the stripping contest, Leo is convinced that his true calling is to be a dancer. Valentin tries to come out to his father, but his mother interrupts by telling her husband that Gaby is pregnant with her son´s child. Astrid prepares a game of keys in her house to help Siena "get over" Adriana. However, nothing will go as planned.

episodes.title: Amazonas, guerreras, embarazadas y caballeros águila
episodes.summary: In this new game of keys some will find love, others disappointment. One will find financial backing for his wife´s booming new project; while others, toyed by the decisions of those capricious keys will end up being paired with the people they hate the most. If that wasn´t enough, coming home from the key game, Gaby will find Mica making out and drinking beer with a till then unknown "boyfriend."

episodes.title: Revelación de género
episodes.summary: Adriana and Barbara successfully pass the exam of their first bachelorette party. Meanwhile, Amelia has organized a gender reveal party for Gaby's baby. She has gone to the extreme as to ask Adriana and Oscar to pretend they are still together and that Valentín and Gaby are the happy couple expecting. All the ingredients are set for an EXPLOSIVE PARTY!

episodes.title: El primero de muchos patanes
episodes.summary: Adriana does almost the impossible to get closer to Mica, while romancing Guillermo and breaking Siena´s heart. Astrid calls Venecia, Siena´s sister begging her to come rescue her sister who is "sick": with love. Valentín starts seeing what his father´s rage can do. Gaby and Oscar see no future together. Barbara finally accepts to marry Leo.

episodes.title: ¡Vamos a la playa!
episodes.summary: Everyone travels to the beach to celebrate Barbara and Leo's wedding. Everything that happens there will leave questions open for a long time: Does Adriana really prefers her new life? Is Oscar going to be a dad for Gaby´s baby? Will Valentín finally find love? As Venecia, her sister joins her; will Siena finally get over Adriana? Will Gloria be satisfied with "this" kind of wedding?

episodes.title: Tenemos que hablar
episodes.summary: Adriana has left, and Óscar deals with her departure. Leo, Bárbara, and Carmen see their relationship deteriorate as a result of working on bachelorette parties. Valentín looks for work while he adapts to his new life without luxuries with Rubén, but an event will leave a mark on the lives of the group of friends. Also, Olivia, Gaby's childhood friend, returns to town with Samuel, her husband.

episodes.title: Como las curitas, de chingadazo
episodes.summary: Olivia confesses who the baby's real father is, which leaves Óscar and Valentín rethinking their lives. Bárbara and Carmen insist on having a regular place for bachelorette parties, while Leo has difficulties keeping up with his job as a stripper. Marcelo, Gaby's father, reappears to have a relationship with his grandson but it's not so easy. Samuel and Olivia begin therapy.

episodes.title: Solo jugando se entiende el juego
episodes.summary: Olivia and Samuel face the consequences of participating in their first game of keys. Bárbara, Leo, and Carmen look for a place for their business and bring a new member into the relationship. Valentín deals with his new life as a father, which includes a less than idyllic relationship with Rubén, while witnessing a battle between Amelia and Marcelo as they fight to be the best grandparent.

episodes.title: El Edén
episodes.summary: The long-awaited club is about to open. Its name is El Edén and Olivia works on the final details alongside Daniela, an introverted engineer. Valentín allows Marcelo to enter more into his life. Samuel and Olivia continue with their issues in bed. Leo discovers that Gerónimo is the one who can make the business a success and the inauguration of El Edén ends with a game of keys... a little extreme.

episodes.title: Arregla tu desmadrito
episodes.summary: The inauguration of El Edén caused damages to the place, but the word has spread and the place is a success. Samuel and Olivia have just sorted out one aspect of their love life when a past issue resurfaces. Rubén tries to get Valentín to make amends with his father, but it goes wrong. Leo's stress makes Bárbara unable to take it anymore and she makes an important decision about her marriage.

episodes.title: ¡Los declaro ex marido y ex mujer!
episodes.summary: Bárbara and Leo have decided to get divorced to repair their relationship and nothing is better than throwing a big divorce party. Samuel and Olivia cannot agree on the priorities in their lives. Valentín reconciles with his father and Marcelo invites him to be part of a business. Leo apologizes to Gerónimo. Daniela and Rodrigo are still unable to process what happened in their first game of keys.
